$comment: Connector schema. Every per-CLI quirk lives HERE, never in core logic.
name: connector-name (matches pool name)
bin: binary on PATH to probe for discovery

spawn.$comment-cwd: cwdMode documents how the CLI resolves its project: 'pwd' means the CLI resolves from $PWD so the watcher MUST set PWD and spawn inside --add-dir

authSignatures: strings in output that mean auth/throttle failure

outputExtraction.$comment: how to get the real answer out of stdout+stderr+files
outputExtraction.field: optional json field path or file glob

eventStream.$comment: Optional declarative JSONL adapter. Provider quirks stay here; core emits normalized semantic actions.
args: CLI flags that enable machine-readable streaming
modelPaths: provider model-id paths in priority order

idPaths: provider action id paths in priority order

meter.readerCmd: optional command emitting usedPct as JSON

modelDiscovery.$comment: Optional local CLI model listing. Parsing quirks stay connector-owned.

flags.$comment-stealth: stealth=true: prompts/completions retained by an anonymous provider — opt-in only, never a default

$comment-timeout: Delegates have no implicit wall-clock timeout; use direct --timeout or workflow step.timeoutSec as an explicit opt-in
